items.description: Nov 20: The Mavericks announced Thursday that Exum will undergo season-ending knee surgery.
Nov 12: Beal will undergo season-ending surgery on his left hip, ESPN's Shams Charania reports.

Nov 30: The Hawks recalled Toppin from the G League's College Park Skyhawks on Sunday, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. However, he won't play in Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right shoulder sprain, per Rowland.
Nov 29: Dante (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
Nov 29: Porzingis (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Lauren L. Williams of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.
Nov 29: Young (knee) will be re-evaluated by the Hawks' medical staff in two weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Oct 9: The Celtics have not ruled Tatum (Achilles) out for the 2025-26 season, ESPN's Shams Charania reported on the Pat McAfee Show on Thursday.
Nov 7: Thomas has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and he will be re-evaluated in 3-4 weeks, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
Oct 19: Highsmith (knee) experienced swelling during rehab and will re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Nov 30: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.

note: Source: Ball Don't Lie player injuries feed. Displaying the 10 most relevant recent reports.
